summary: Frontend E2E for GestaoEPI v5.0.9 LGPD consent + size/quantity flows. 14/15 manual UI test steps PASS, 1 minor UI inconsistency (photo upload still visible on Biometria tab when consent denied). Backend persistence (steps 13–14) re-validated via curl: facial_consent True/False with date persists, PDF report contains 'NÃO aceitou uso de biometria facial'. EPIs grouping logic source-verified + persistence verified via /api/epis. Cleanup completed (2 employees + 2 EPIs deleted, all HTTP 200).

ui_bugs.issue: When colaborador has facial_consent=false, the 'Cadastro de biometria bloqueado' banner correctly appears AND 'Iniciar Captura Facial' is correctly hidden, BUT the 'Foto do Colaborador' subsection (with 'Tirar Foto' and 'Selecionar da Galeria' buttons) is still rendered above the blocked banner. This contradicts the consent-deny policy — these buttons are correctly disabled in the new-colaborador dialog (steps 4–5), but on the existing colaborador detail page they remain enabled, allowing an admin to upload a photo of someone who refused biometric consent. Recommend hiding/disabling the 'Foto do Colaborador' panel when colaborador.facial_consent === false.

issues: Console error 'Erro ao carregar imagem: SyntheticBaseEvent' fires twice on every page load — appears to be onError handler logging the SyntheticEvent object instead of a real URL/error. Cosmetic but pollutes logs.

Suppress or fix the 'Erro ao carregar imagem: SyntheticBaseEvent' console.error spam on Login (likely an onError handler logging the event object).

rca of the issue: ColaboradorDetalhes.js renders the 'Cadastro de Biometria Facial' panel with two distinct subsections: (1) 'Foto do Colaborador' (~lines 1500-1620) — always rendered regardless of consent; (2) 'Templates Faciais Cadastrados' (~lines 1620-1660) — correctly wrapped by the biometric-blocked-banner conditional when facial_consent===false. Symmetric gating should be applied to subsection (1) so that 'Tirar Foto' + 'Selecionar da Galeria' buttons (and the photo preview area) are hidden or disabled for non-consenting colaboradores, matching the policy already enforced in Colaboradores.js new-employee dialog (data-testid='btn-capture-photo' + upload label gated by handleConsentDeny).
